step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Detection: Select the investigation type shown in NIIS .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 6 - Earnings other than declared .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li:
Remarks Line 1: Type the appropriate option:
For PSL : E (Earnings) :
Input M175 E — [amount to be allocated] from [w/c (first day of allocation)] to [s/c (last day of allocation)], [type the amount to be allocated on the last week if different].”
For WLI: F (Wage Loss Insurance) :
Input [M175 F — [amount to be allocated] from [w/c (first day of allocation)] to [w/c (last day of allocation)], [type the amount to be allocated on the last week if different].”
Remarks Line 2: Use if more than one week or more than one type of earnings must be allocated.
Remarks Line 3: Leave the field blank.
Remarks Line 4: Leave the field blank.
Remarks Line 5: Type your first name and last name.
